text:
zoe: Quick JIT ask — we need a compact benchmark launch micro-kit for a partner post. Scope: one hero (web), three social variants, a one-slide explainer image, and 1 animated GIF (loop). Turnaround: 48h.

dan: Got it. Can we keep it single-tone (brand) and produce a high-contrast alt color for accessibility? Also need three headline variants for A/B.

yra: I'll take creative. Specs: hero 1600x900, social square 1080x1080, social tall 1080x1350, link preview 1200x628, GIF 800x450 5s loop. Source: Figma.

designbot: Export rules:
```
- Hero: 1600x900 @72dpi, provide 1x + 2x
- Social: PNG sRGB, include alt-text in metadata
- GIF: 5s loop, 24fps, keep <2.5MB; provide WebM fallback
- Slide explainer: PNG 1200x675, include footnote area for metric source
```

zoe: Messaging: headline variants: 1) "Cut token costs by design" 2) "Keep latency low, costs lower" 3) "Serve smarter: inference economics" Primary CTA: "See the benchmark". UTM: utm_source=partner, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=mini-bench-xq1.

dan: For partner co-branding: partner logo in footer 120px high, 24px padding. Use partner palette only on accent elements. Provide PSD/Figma with locked layers for partner.

yra: Add accessible color pass: default + high-contrast (text ratio >= 4.5:1). Also include captioned alt text for GIFs.

legal: Flag: do not include absolute savings claims without a source. If we use "Cut token costs by X%" add a footnote with test conditions. Also provide partner-approved trademark usage.

comms: We'll need social copy variations (short, medium, long) and three hashtags. I'll draft once assets land. Also ask: should the one-slide explainer include a short methodology blurb?

e: yes (typo) zoe: yes — include a 2-line methodology note and a small source footnote area in the slide.

dan: I'm adding CRM tag for partner referrals: set lead.source_detail = "partner_xq1" and add utm_campaign mapping. Delivery folder: marketing-assets/mini-bench/xq1 and tag `mini-bench/partner-xq1`.

designbot: Upload link (dev): https://figma.com/file/microkitxq1 — exported files named: MICRO_BENCH_HERO_EN.png, MICRO_BENCH_SOC_1080.png, MICRO_BENCH_GIF_800x450.webm. README will include alt text and color contrast cert.

yra: I'll push first-pass images in ~6h. Will ping legal for any copy changes.

zoe: Thanks all — target handoff in 6-8h, final delivery in 48h. :sparkles:
